name: Lumax Auto Technologies Limited
summary: Lumax Auto Technologies Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells automotive components in India. The company offers advanced plastics, such as panels, centre consoles, door panels, headliners and interior trim systems, air intake systems, urea and plastic fuel tanks, headliners, trims, louvers, head lamps, tail lamps, and front and rear fenders; mechatronics, including power window switches, oxygen sensors, telematics control units, shark fin antennas, telematics antennas, and emission control management solutions; structures and control systems comprising gear shifter, metallic chassis and swing arm for 2-wheelers; aftermarket products, such as lighting, bulbs, horns,…
